device_identification: Unbalanced Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) with 1x2 MMI splitter and 2x1 MMI combiner. Two waveguide arms are folded into vertically-stacked stadium/racetrack arches (one bulging up, one bulging down) sharing the same horizontal extent but with DIFFERENT heights, giving a non-zero optical path-length difference (delta_length).
how_it_works: Light enters the left port through an input taper (0.5 um tip -> 0.97 um) into a wide multimode region (2.56 um x 5.5 um solid rectangle = 1x2 MMI). Self-imaging in the MMI splits the field 50/50 into the two arms. Each arm is a stadium: it fans out from the MMI output, turns to vertical, runs a straight section, rounds a 180-degree cap (radius = half the stadium width), returns down the far vertical, and fans back into the combiner. The TOP arm is shorter (cap center ~+12.35 um above the bus) than the BOTTOM arm (cap center ~-17.41 um below the bus). The path-length difference delta_length ~= 2 x (bottom_straight - top_straight) ~= 10.1 um. The two arms recombine in the mirror-image 2x1 MMI and exit the right output taper. The delta_length sets the interferometer free spectral range FSR = lambda^2 / (n_g * delta_length).

function_defining_knobs.delta_length: arm optical path-length difference (um) -> sets FSR. Implemented as extra straight length added symmetrically to the bottom arm's two vertical sections.
function_defining_knobs.wg_width: routing waveguide width in the arms (~0.54 um).
function_defining_knobs.mmi_width: MMI multimode region width (~2.56 um) -> governs the self-imaging split.
function_defining_knobs.mmi_taper_length / mmi_taper_width / por: access taper geometry feeding/leaving the MMI (tip 0.5 -> 0.97 um over ~8.3 um).
function_defining_knobs.mmi_out_offset: half the center-to-center separation of the two MMI output ports (~0.625 um).
function_defining_knobs.cap_radius: 180-degree arm cap radius = half stadium width (~10.04 um).
function_defining_knobs.turn_radius / fanout_len: geometry of the S-approach from the MMI outputs up/down into the vertical stadium sides.
function_defining_knobs.base_arm_straight: vertical straight length of the (shorter) top arm; bottom arm = base + delta_length/2.

measurements_um.bus_row_y0_axis: device axis (input/output bus) offset from image vertical center; arms asymmetric about it

iterations.change_made: Initial MZI: 1x2 MMI rects + two stadium arms via arc(90)+straight+arc(180)+straight. delta_length=10.12 knob extends bottom arm.
Fixed fanout_len arithmetic (14.48->16.48) so vertical sides land at x=35.48/55.56 and arms reach the combiner.
Rebuilt arm as explicit points: quarter-ellipse S-approach + rounded-rectangle cap (quarter-circle corners + flat top) instead of circular 90 turns + semicircle.
Replaced approach with tunable cubic Bezier (bez_t/bez_u); swept corner_radius (peak Rc=7.45, base=6.19 with cap apex pinned at 22.39um).
Added bez_v (shoulder-outward handle) to match the S-approach curve; swept bez_t/bez_u/bez_v (peak t=18.5,u=7.8,v=1.5).

Arms now taper mmi_out_width(0.97)->wg_width(0.54) over the approach via gf.path.extrude_transition (fixes shoulder under-fill); swept taper_frac (0.32), corner_radius (7.45), wg_width (0.54). Flatten before write_gds so the device is a clean top-level cell. HONEST BEST.

final.note: Primitives-only (gf.Path+extrude, extrude_transition, rectangle, taper, straight); no gf.components device stencils, no raw polygons. Plateaued at IoU~0.81; residual error is ~1-3px boundary wobble distributed over the long thin-waveguide perimeter (cap-apex shape detail + S-approach), near the resolution floor for thin-line IoU. wg_width=0.54 is the honest measured width (fattening lowered IoU).
